REASONING: Prior levered long-value ideas performed poorly, so this treats debt-heavy valuation as an overhang rather than cheapness. Weak operating income after depreciation makes the debt burden harder to grow out of, increasing the chance that apparent value belongs to creditors rather than equity holders.
